name: Planned Parenthood – Durham Health Center
description: Birth control, emergency contraception, STI/HIV testing and treatment, pregnancy testing, cancer screenings, vaccines and abortion. In person or telehealth.
access: Insurance not required. Walk-ins welcome (including for emergency contraception). Se habla español.
notes: Low- or no-cost birth control, STI/HIV testing and treatment, pregnancy tests and cancer screenings for those who qualify under Title X, through at least March 31, 2027 (call 1-800-230-7526 to check).

notes: Payment is due at the visit unless arranged ahead; ask about lower-cost options.
